rules.sentence: Finally, the dermatologist should also know the importance of getting a skin biopsy of appropriate depth and dimensions to avoid missing the diagnosis.[1]
Hence, educating healthcare workers about identifying and performing routine workups before referring to the dermatologist is an important part of enhancing healthcare.
Although the incidence of liver abscess is low, it is essential to early detect and manage these lesions, since there is a significant mortality risk in untreated patients.
